# Basic Prose

Plain paragraph with **bold**, *italic*, ***bold italic***, and _underscore italic_.
Nested **bold with *italic* inside** and a [link](https://example.com/path?a=1&b=2).

Special characters: 50% off, R&D, item #3, snake_case, tilde ~ and "quoted text".

Escaped markdown: \*not italic\*, \_not\_ emphasis, \# not heading.

## Lists

- First item
- Second item with `inline_code()`
  - Nested item
- Third item

1. Ordered one
2. Ordered two

### Deeper Heading

> An epigraph or quoted passage
> spanning two lines.

* * *

Text after a scene break.

Text after a horizontal rule.
